metadata.description: dev | uat | prod.
Azure region.
Registry login server for THIS environment, e.g. crdijionenonprod.azurecr.io (dev/uat) or crdijioneprod.azurecr.io (prod).
Registry name, e.g. crdijionenonprod.
Resource group the registry lives in (rg-dijione-shared for dev/uat; rg-dijione-prod for prod).
service -> sha256 digest, e.g. { "platform-api": "sha256:abc..." }. When set it MUST cover every deployed service.
Fallback tag for a first bring-up only, when imageDigests is empty. A git SHA.
Deploy DijiBirthday (people-api, birthday-api, birthday-web, birthday-supplier-web + 2 jobs).
Deploy the commercial-api skeleton.
Container size — lean floor by default (Amendment 8).
Per-service replica floor. Empty = every service scales to zero (DEV/UAT). PROD sets platform-api + shell-web to 1.
Default replica ceiling and per-service overrides.
DEV only: create a Manual bootstrap-identity job that seeds the 5 staff dev-login personas (no business data). UAT/PROD create real users via the Admin Center.

Create a Manual bootstrap-talent-clients job that runs talent-api/scripts/seed.py — it pulls the canonical client directory from platform-api (GET /api/platform/internal/clients) and creates ONLY the talent_dev.clients extension rows (platform_client_id + name), idempotent, no business data. Needed for the governed DTC tag -> Client resolution.

Internal identity mode for platform-api. "dev" = the passwordless persona switcher; "entra" = real Microsoft Entra ID OIDC (Authorization Code + PKCE). "entra" also requires entraTenantId, entraClientId, publicBaseUrl, and the entra-client-secret-<env> Key Vault secret.
Entra directory (tenant) id. Only used when authMode == entra.
Application (client) id of the per-environment DijiOne Entra app registration. Only used when authMode == entra.
Public HTTPS origin of shell-web for this environment, e.g. https://shell-web.<env-domain>. Backs the Entra redirect URI and the front-channel logout redirect.

recruitment-api provider mode. "mock" = MockLeverClient; "live" = the GET-only LiveLeverClient, which also needs the lever-api-key-<env> Key Vault secret. Lever is READ-ONLY by construction (CLAUDE.md §60).

people-api provider mode. "mock" = MockBambooHrClient; "live" = the read-only live client, which also needs the bamboohr-api-key-<env> Key Vault secret and bamboohrSubdomain. Never writes to BambooHR.
BambooHR company subdomain (the <sub> in api.bamboohr.com/api/gateway.php/<sub>/v1). Only used when peopleIntegrationsMode == live.

birthday-api People-source mode. "mock" = MockEmployeeSource; "live" = PeopleApiEmployeeSource (consumes people-api over HTTP; birthday-api still holds NO BambooHR credential and no employee mirror). EMAIL_SENDING_MODE stays mock regardless (Phase 1 §1.9).

Birthday Supplier Portal auth. "dev" = the seeded SupplierUser persona picker; "entra" = real Microsoft Entra ID B2B guest sign-in (Auth Code + PKCE) via birthday-api, which also needs the birthday-supplier-entra-secret-<env> Key Vault secret. Independent of the internal DijiOne authMode.
Entra directory (tenant) id for supplier B2B guest sign-in. Only used when supplierAuthMode == entra. Same directory as the internal tenant.
Application (client) id of the per-environment dijione-birthday-supplier Entra app registration. Only used when supplierAuthMode == entra.
Public HTTPS origin of birthday-supplier-web, e.g. https://birthday-supplier-web.<env-domain>. Backs the supplier Entra redirect URI.
